decimal_convention: Endpoints are the literal decimal nominal mean minus/plus its retained SD, converted once to native finite JSON numbers for existing requests. No floating subtraction, clipping or fitted endpoint selection.
parameter_policy: One taxon PPE mean changes at a time, shared by regional REVEALS, local LOVE and target forward context. PPE_SD, fall speeds, taxonomy, count vectors, regional source selection, bin support, rings and geometry stay nominal. Existing engine uncertainty omissions remain truthful.
population: Each scenario requests all3existing physicalplaces and all6bins/18folds. Four scenarios request72folds. Three methods have one local predictor and are dependent, not independent validation. Existing nominal results/epochs remain immutable.
source_use: Reuse original source epochs, source_window_authority and admitted conditional Neotoma inputs only; no additional source-use or ecological approval. Small-lake regional proxies remain conditional.
exposure: Prior-exposed development design; baseline predictions, scores and direct comparison were available before declaration. Freeze this protocol before alternative outcomes. No untouched confirmation or tuning by score.
estimand: Same Betula/Ulmus panel and exact half-open native pooled windows. Compare only matched target/support/parameter scenario rows; preserve all predicted/refused/fatal/not-run and failed eligible mass.
interpretation: Deterministic one-axis domain sensitivity only. No probability weights, confidence interval, coverage, covariance law, calibrated ecological uncertainty, vegetation accuracy, field/rights approval or superiority claim.
omitted: Joint PPE uncertainty, count/regional-background uncertainty, chronology/geometry/spatial-model uncertainty, correlated parameter domains and independent measured-vegetation validation remain open.
failure_policy: No clipping analytical LOVE. All requested folds/methods retained, including invalid_composition. Known scientific refusals remain refused; unknown exceptions fatal with later bins not_run. Scoring occurs only after complete prediction products are frozen/reopened.
source_parameters: Original Swedish/Nordic protocol and parameters evidence supplies nominal PPE and SD; these are conditional published parameter assumptions rather than measured site-specific calibration.
